messages:
Hannah (CS): Heads-up: Renewal flag on AuroraWorks after a 20% token cost spike and p99 latency drift. Rev rec: quick compact-int8 pilot + split routing for long docs. Need numbers and a short customer one-pager.
Marco (SE): Can run a staging split. Want to route seq_len<=1100 to compact-int8 with prefix_kv on, else standard-fp16.
Devika (RE): I can run fidelity checks on their top 8k prompts (consent ok). Will measure embedding drift, BLEU, and hallucination heuristics.
Owen (AE): Customer cares about accuracy. If any critical-case regressions, we must rollback. Need pilot timeline before renewal call Wednesday.
AlertBot: [monitoring] auroraworks-prod token_cost +20% window=2025-11-02T10:00Z->2025-11-02T16:00Z p95=0.9s p99=2.4s
Marco (SE): Deploy snippet for staging: ```route { match: "/v1/summarize" condition: "seq_len <= 1100" split: "80/15" models: ["redwood-compact-1-int8","redwood-standard-1-fp16"] fallback: "dedicated-small" } cache: { prefix_kv: true } batching: { max_batch_ms: 50 }```
Devika (RE): I'll include per-length buckets and flag any prompts with >2% faithfulness drop.
Hannah (CS): Action items: Marco94staging perf & dashboard (ETA 3h), Devika94evals + flagged cases (ETA 5h), Owen94stakeholder sync scheduling (ETA EOD). Keep comms short for the AE to share.
Owen (AE): I'll prep a one-pager template with rollback criteria and savings estimate.
Marco (SE): Deploying staging now. Will post p50/p95/p99 and token_cpm delta.
Hannah (CS): Thanks team, small pilot with clear rollback should buy us time on renewal. :thumbsup:
